artifact.not_redistributed: the artifact is published as parts with SHA256SUMS; it is not part of this submission

toolchain.runtime_libraries: libcudart and libcublasLt from the CUDA 13.3 toolkit; FFmpeg and libcurl from the system (not redistributed)

runtime_prerequisites: Linux x86-64 with one 32 GB-class NVIDIA GPU (RTX 5090, sm_120a) and a CUDA 13.x driver/toolkit
About 65 GiB host RAM for pinned experts with --ngram-residency stream, and about 127 GB disk for the artifact
CMake 3.28+, Ninja, a C++23 host compiler
FFmpeg development libraries (libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil, libswscale) and libcurl 7.85+
Python 3.11 with numpy and torch for conversion; the runtime needs none
